content.text: I changed `core/sbom.py` so CycloneDX reviews the product's sub-components (`metadata.component.components`, at any depth) without reviewing the product itself, and so a document carrying both `bomFormat` (CycloneDX) and `spdxVersion` (SPDX) is refused with a `FormatError` saying it carries both formats. I could not run code or tests, so this is checked by reading only.
